title: FOLR：三臂状态清理候选，随机p=.1明确不匹配频率
context: Claim: event-triggered survivor clearing may outperform retention and one preset random law at equal real training exposure. Binding MARL structure: roster change and other-agent non-stationarity/partial observability. After all three pairs, freeze prospective design only; B03 reversed the earlier signs. No implementation or scientific invocation is allocated.

options.consequence: 撤回未运行候选，保留三对历史结果和只读准备证据。

无同信息调优基线/上界headroom；没有纯事件因果、过时记忆、正则化原因、稳定赢家或迁移主张。

packet.verdict_text:
**Recommendation:** prepare one three-law B candidate with a preset **unmatched p=.1**
random-clearing arm, the same real training recipe and128 once-fixed final episodes per
arm. Confidence that EVENT will usefully beat both nulls is lower after B03. Nevertheless,
the extra legal control can change which trained memory rule merits a later bounded
follow-up; another unchanged pair cannot observe that comparator. This is a performance
question with a deliberately limited timing/dose interpretation, not a claim that event
clearing is already useful or that a causal explanation must precede learning. Existing
trustworthy positive points can justify bounded exploration despite a new opposing sign
under evidence-spec §§11.8.2–3. This recommendation does not itself allocate its compute.
